body:
@Haroenv Any idea how we could make things easier to allow for selective imports along with not having to re-recreate an InstantSearch?

I would go for:

* easy to import InstantSearch without having to re-create it
* check if babel-plugin-lodash or babel-plugin-import (https://github.com/ant-design/babel-plugin-import) can work with react-instantsearch (see https://github.com/callemall/material-ui/issues/5625#issuecomment-267965302)
* if not maybe create a babel-plugin-react-instantsearch
* document all this in a tree-shaking guide
